verdict: Spend is live; zero leads returned — conversion path still being built.
narrative: In the last 28 days, $104.96 was spent across Meta — primarily through the WARM-RETARGETING campaign — generating 210 clicks but zero leads. No leads were produced because the landing pages, conversion tracking, and lead routing that turn clicks into inquiries are not yet live; the spend is running ahead of the infrastructure it needs. Work to close those gaps is the immediate priority, and until it is complete, paid results will stay at zero regardless of click volume. Once the conversion path is in place, the existing traffic gives us a real baseline to optimize from.
